## The Truth About Cybersecurity Marketing

How to simplify complex threats without creating panic

Sep 08, 2025

1

Share

Transcript

This is part of our CyberGrowth series, an initiative we started while we were running our agency, before we pivoted into building our AI Sales Intelligence platform. In the CyberGrowth series, we discuss proven strategies and tactics to help cybersecurity sales and marketing leaders accelerate their business growth.

---

#### Episode Summary

In this conversation, Eve Oliver, the marketing manager of Computer Services Group (CSG), discusses her journey in cybersecurity marketing, the importance of cyber resilience for small businesses, and the strategies CSG employs to educate clients about cybersecurity threats.

She emphasises the need for tailored solutions, the role of trust in customer relationships, and the significance of ongoing research in the ever-evolving cybersecurity landscape.

Eve also shares insights on the balance between raising awareness and not instilling fear, as well as the future trends in cybersecurity, particularly regarding AI threats.

Transcript

In S7E14 of the Brilliance Security Magazine Podcast, we welcome Alex Brennan, Vice President of Global Enterprise Sales at Sign In Solutions, to explore the emerging role of visitor management in modern physical security strategies. In this episode, titled “Securing the Front Door: How Visitor Management Became a Security Imperative,” Alex and host Steven Bowcut dive into how converged threat models are turning the front desk into a vital security checkpoint — and why managing risk doesn’t have to come at the expense of a positive visitor experience.

## Summary

Visitor management systems are no longer just a matter of courtesy or logistics — they are a cornerstone of physical security and compliance in high-risk and highly regulated environments. Alex Brennan opens the conversation by sharing his personal journey from early curiosity in business and technology to helping launch and scale Traction Guest, which later became Sign In Solutions. ## A security analytics software firm with an already well-established customer base will continue to grow based on increasing demand for their service and a transition to a SaaS model.

## Company Overview

Market cap at publishing: $1.77B

Price at publishing: $26.86

Cognyte Software is a global leader in security analytics software. They provide services to governments and enterprises worldwide. The company’s open software is used to successfully identify, neutralize, and prevent national security, personal safety, business continuity, and cyber threats. They have over a thousand governmental and private clients. Cognyte Software was incorporated in 2020 as a spinoff of one of Verint’s business units and is headquartered in Herzliya, Israel.

## Financials

The company was just spun off in March 2021 so there won’t be any in-depth analysis on their financials or growth.
